title: Find the display names of users who posted comments with a score between 1
question: Find the display names of users who posted comments with a score between 1 and 5 on posts that have fewer than 100 views and a post score of zero. These users must have never cast any downvotes, created their accounts before 2015, and last accessed the site after September 1, 2014.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u."XCL_055"
FROM users u
JOIN comments c ON c."XCL_010" = u."XCL_052"
JOIN posts p ON p."XCL_026" = c."XCL_006"
WHERE c."XCL_007" BETWEEN 1 AND 5
  AND p."XCL_030" < 100
  AND p."XCL_031" = 0
  AND u."XCL_054" < '2015-01-01'
  AND u."XCL_056" > '2014-09-01'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM votes v
    WHERE v."XCL_070" = u."XCL_052" AND v."XCL_068" = 2
  )
